fact: At its board meeting in Rabat under the Head of Government, the telecommunications regulator ANRT took decisions on generalising telecom coverage, a campaign to identify poorly covered zones, fibre reinforcement and 5G deployment, with 80 billion MAD of planned investment and 85% of the population covered by 2030, within the Maroc Digital 2030 strategy.
title: ANRT: cap sur la couverture intégrale et le déploiement 5G
